name: arch
description: Paid theological review of faith text, plus a free offline KJV verse lookup.
long_description: Two tools. `arch_review` sends sermon, devotional, or Bible-study text to the Arch API and returns a review with suggestions. Each paid review costs $2.00 or less and needs an Arch API key from https://arch.tnvolman.com/#access. If the key is missing or the API errors, it returns an error and never a made-up pass. `kjv_lookup` returns King James verses from a bundled offline copy, with no key and no network.

arch_api_key.title: Arch API Key
arch_api_key.description: Your Arch API key from https://arch.tnvolman.com/#access. Required for arch_review, which sends it as the X-API-Key header and fails closed without it. Not used by kjv_lookup.
